buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must submit an affidavit of Rs.100 stamp paper dully signed by the Judicial Magistrate 1st Cl ass, regarding not blacklisted/debarred ever by any Govt./Semi Govt. organization/corporation at any stag e and time. 2.The bidder will have to give an undertaking before the closing of the bid date that no One of our relatives is involved in ANEs or is residing in Pakistan. 3.All bidders shall submit their CA certificate with UDIN number declaring their Annual Turnover. 4.All bidders shall submit their ITR and GSTR copies of recent financial years in the bid which is mandatory for technical qualification of the bidder. 5.All bidders must have to submit their completion certificate relevant to the work for which biding is takin g place along with the certified copy of work order issued by any competent authority. 6. Pre-Bid meeting is compulsory to attend to understand the assignment to achieve the desire d results without any lapse and delay on dated 03 November, 2026 11:00 AM at mention time sharply. 7.EMD is must for all bidders- resellers as well as OEM's. Non submission of EMD will disqualify the bidder. 8.Hard copy of original EMD must reach the office of the undersigned on or before the bid closing date. 9.T he bidder must be submitting hard copy of Police Character Certificate before closing the date of the Bid. 10.Rate sheet/offer price list must be uploaded properly as per the given bid items & quantity. 11. This office is authorized to cancel the bidders offer at any point of time provided that the conditions m entioned in ATC are not fulfilled. .
